When you name a speaker, Prime Minutes can remember what that person sounds like, and suggest their name in your next meetings.

• Everything stays on this phone. Voices are never uploaded, and they are left out of exports and backups.
• A voice is a list of numbers computed from up to 60 s of the person's speech in your meetings, not a recording.
• Suggestions are only suggestions: a name is never set without your tap.
• You can forget one person's voice, or delete all voice data, at any time. Deleting a meeting deletes the voice samples it gave.
• Ask people before you name them: in some places a voice print is personal data that needs their consent.
